text:
Avery: Quick async standup — hotpath KV + batching. TL;DR: aiming to land prefetch + batching scheduler by EOW. Need owners for kernel prefetch patch, batching scheduler, and CR review for kv-eviction. Any blockers?

Priya: I'm owner for the prefetch patch (PR #492). Plan to push updates today. Biggest blocker is a flaky test in kernel::kv that times out in CI.

Jun: I'll take batching scheduler changes. Can we split into two PRs: scheduler core + canary flags? avoids large rollbacks.

Sasha: CI flakes I saw last night look like race in warmup path. Stack snippet:
```
runtime/hotpath/warmup.cpp: line 214: CHECK(kv_cache->ready())
```
Repro steps in weave-k8s are intermittent.

Avery: Good call on PR split @Jun. @Priya can you post the failing test log? We should triage before we land prefetch.

Priya: Pasted gist: https://gist.github.com/priya/abcd1234 — timeout at 120s, log shows repeated eviction thrash.

Lina: I can help debug eviction thrash. I think eviction heuristic math under high batch concurrency goes negative and causes mass evict. I'll run a repro with sustained 2k qps.

Omar: FYI, production canary showed ~6% p95 increase yesterday during burst window when prefetch was enabled (canary build 2026-03-10-3). Reverted for safety.

Raj: @Omar can you attach the perf trace? need flamegraph. Also which kernel variant was canary on? quantized-int8?

Omar: Attached: s3://redwood-prod-perf/canaries/2026-03-10-3/trace.json. Kernel variant = nv-optimized-8bit.

Devin: Quick ask — can we add a fallback policy in runtime-routing so if kv-prefetch fails we fall back to no-prefetch mode? Minimal config change:
```
fallthrough.prefetch = "off_on_error"
```
could avoid broad regressions.

Avery: Agree — add config + feature flag. @Jun add scheduler canary flag, @Priya add fallback hook in prefetch PR, @Lina help reproduce eviction. Target: get two small PRs by EOD Thurs, canary on Fri morning.

Sasha: I'll queue a kernel test job that stresses eviction and warmup on the CI cluster. Tagging @ci-bot to run nightly: :eyes:

ci-bot: started nightly-stress job #314 on cluster-ci-3 — ETA 40m

Priya: ETA for fixing flaky test: today afternoon. If I can't root cause, I'll add a short-term mutex around eviction to unblock landing.

Jun: PR plan: core scheduler (no default change), flag + canary rollout in separate PR. Pinging @eng-sre for canary ramp.

Lina: Repro running now locally with 2k qps. Initial log shows eviction rate spike at ~30s; sharing results in channel when complete.

Avery: Perfect. Owners and actions:
- Priya: prefetch PR + fallback hook (owner)
- Jun: batching scheduler core + canary PR (owner)
- Lina: eviction repro + triage (owner)
- Sasha: CI stress job + kernel test (owner)
- Omar: perf traces + canary rollback playbook (owner)

If anyone else has cross-team deps (infra, model-serving, release), drop them here. Otherwise we'll sync Friday morning briefly if canary is green. :thumbsup:

Raj: Infra note — we'll need a small increase in canary pool (from 5% -> 10%) to hit the burst shape. I'll coordinate with @eng-sre.

Devin: CR ping: Priya @Priya please add me as reviewer on #492 when ready. I'll focus on fallback logic.

Priya: Will do. Thanks everyone — i'll update thread with PR links and test logs.

Avery: Thanks. Closing async loop — ping here for any blockers. :sparkles:
